verdict.rationale: Teller's docs describe connecting via 'Verify Account Details via Microdeposit' and general account-linking language, but nowhere document OAuth coverage of major institutions or a retirement plan for legacy credential-based flows. Community evidence actually points the other way — the founder compares Teller's terms to 'incumbent screen-scrapers in the market, e.g. Yodlee and Plaid,' and users note banks disclaim liability 'if you give your online banking credentials to a third party,' indicating credential-based (not bank-hosted OAuth) connections were in use historically.
